name: agentic
description: General-purpose plugins for Agentic Project. Nothing domain-specific.

plugins.name: Git Graph
plugins.description: Reads the commit history of any repository this project declares, and draws it as a branch graph in its own desktop tab.

plugins.name: Computer Updater
plugins.description: Checks this machine for outdated software via winget (including Microsoft Store sources) and reports what needs updating. It never installs anything.
